label: Pricing violations
subgoals: Count the route's steps and vias
Count the violations it would create
Add length, via cost and violation penalty

label: Choosing among candidates
subgoals: Price each candidate with the same cost function
Keep the cheapest, usually a slightly longer clean route

label: Rules as blocked tracks
subgoals: Compute the edge gap to each neighbouring track
Compare each gap with the spacing the rule table requires
Block the tracks whose gap is too small
